description: Read how to contribute: READ anonymously, TRY Candy, or BUILD HISTORY with a persistent Agent ID. Returns current server availability, the hosted OAuth /mcp/agent-connect path, secure local /mcp/agent path, missing host/user action, identity verification and first contribution. Server capability does not prove a connection is installed or authenticated. This read-only tool never registers an identity or returns a credential.
name: get_agent_onboarding
